title: Comparison of ideal-data powers with recursive image powers
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $I$ ideal-sheaf data [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Let $(P_n,j_n)$ be its recursive image powers [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk]. For every $n\geq0$, the module attached to $I^n$ is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent], and there is an isomorphism $e:(I^n)^{\mathrm{mod}}\cong P_n$ with $j_n e=(I^n)^{\mathrm{mod}}\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X$. The zeroth power is included.

source.place: Tags 01I8 and 01IC, affine quasi-coherent modules and tensor products; the affine ideal-product calculation used in Tag 01YB.

proof.text: The module of any ideal-sheaf data J is the kernel of the structure sheaf map to the closed-subscheme structure-sheaf pushforward. The unit modules are quasi-coherent, the closed immersion is qcqs, its pushforward is quasi-coherent, and kernels preserve quasi-coherence. Apply this also to J = I^n.

For a quasi-coherent ideal module K and quasi-coherent module M, the affine tensor comparison sends pure tensors to scalar multiples under multiplication. Tensor induction computes the range as range(K -> O) times M(U). The affine image formula transfers this range to the categorical image inclusion. Quasi-coherence of tensor products, cokernels and kernels gives quasi-coherence of the multiplication image.

Induct on positive recursive powers. The first power is I.toModules; at every further step map the multiplication range through the preceding inclusion. Submodule.map_smul, range_comp and I times I^n = I^(n+1) give affine range I(U)^n. The zeroth power inclusion is the identity and has full range. Ideal-data powers have the same affine range by range_toModulesι_app and ideal_pow. All recursive inclusions are mono by induction since image inclusions and composites of monos are mono.

For mono inclusions i and j whose affine ranges are contained, i followed by cokernel(j) vanishes on every affine open. Sheaf separatedness on the affine basis gives global vanishing. The kernel universal property and the invertibility of the abelian factor-through-image of j yield a factorization of i through j. Apply this in both directions to get equality of subobjects. Subobject.isoOfMkEqMk and ofMkLEMk_comp supply the isomorphism with the stated inclusion compatibility.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01I8 and 01IC, affine tensor and image calculation; Tag 01LC for qcqs pushforward. J4 implements the multiplication-range and positive-power induction locally to avoid the import cycle through the planned affine-sections module.

lean.statement:
theorem idealData_recursive_power_comparison {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (n : ℕ) :
    (I ^ n).toModules.IsQuasicoherent ∧
      ∃ e : (I ^ n).toModules ≅ (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).1,
        e.hom ≫ (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).2 = (I ^ n).toModulesι
